title: Conduit frame envelope
description: Every frame on the wire is one of these.

t.description: The frame type, from the registry in spec/frames.json.

s.description: The schema id of the payload: reverse DNS with a version.

c.description: The channel the frame belongs to.

i.description: The call id, for frames that answer a call.

seq.description: The sequence number of this frame in the tunnel.
